summary: Extracts the low 7 bits of the dword at this+0x2C, subtracts bias 64, and scales the result by 0.015873017 (1/63) to produce a double. Trivial thiscall decoder; no guards and no calls.

operations.description: Read dword at this+0x2C, mask with 0x7F to isolate the low 7-bit biased signed value, then subtract bias 64
Multiply the biased-extracted integer by 0.015873017 (scale factor at flt_5ACCDC) to produce the double result
Return the scaled value as a double
